title: Basic Level 1 Arrays 17

content.problemStatement:
Given three integer arrays, the task is to find three integers, one from each array such that they sum up to a given target value X. Print the output depending on whether such triplet exits or not.

Examples:

    Input: arr1[]={2} , arr2[]={11,6,7} ,arr3[]={4,5},X=12

    Output:Yes

    arr1[0]+arr2[1]+arr[3]=2+6+4=12
content.inputFormat:
The first line has the size of each arrays.

Next lines have the elements of the arrays.

And the last line has the X values
content.outputFormat:
Print the first triplet if found else print "No such triplets"

Note:

    Print the first occurance the triplets.

solution.approach: Process inputs via standard stream input and apply required transformations.

hints: Can sorting the array simplify the problem, or does sorting take too long compared to a hash table lookup?
Consider two-pointer approaches if the array is sorted, or a sliding window if looking for contiguous subarrays.
Prefix sums or prefix XORs can answer range sum queries in O(1) time after O(N) preprocessing.
